jobs.description:
As a part-time order picker at AS Watson, you play an important role in supplying well-known stores like Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL. You work at the distribution center in Heteren, where a headset tells you exactly which products to pick and where to place them. You handle both small and larger products, walk a lot, and keep your fitness up at the same time. You can choose your own shifts: morning (06:00–14:00), afternoon (14:00–22:00), or night (22:00–06:00, for 3-shift schedule). Prefer to work weekends only? That's possible too! Apply today and we'll discuss the options with you. 

- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available at least 16 hours per week
- Available at least one Saturday every 4 weeks. 
- You are fit enough to walk a lot
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren
- You want to work in shifts

Get started in logistics at a growing DHL location

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and start working quickly? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for warehouse employees.

This is a site that is still developing: new clients are regularly being onboarded, so no two days are the same and you will continuously learn new tasks.

What will you do?

- Picking orders using a scanning system
- Checking and replenishing products
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Supporting various processes depending on the client
- Ensuring a clean and safe working environment

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate in three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are available 32 to 40 hours per week
- You are flexible and can perform multiple tasks
- You are physically capable of warehouse work
- You speak Dutch or English

Experience is not required – motivation and commitment are more important. You will receive proper training and learn the job step by step.

At AS Watson in Oosterhout, we are looking for new colleagues who are ready for a fresh logistics challenge. Are you searching for a varied role in a pleasant and motivating work environment, and are you willing to work in two shifts with allowances up to 150 percent? Then the AS Watson warehouse is the ideal place to continue your logistics career.

As an order picker, you ensure that orders for the Kruidvat stores are prepared accurately and on time. You work with a modern voice‑picking system that guides you through the warehouse. This system is available in three languages: Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with this system and your colleagues, you collect orders for stores in the south of the Netherlands and Belgium.

With your organizational skills, you stack the goods efficiently on the pallets. You can expect a wide range of products, such as soft drinks, toothpaste, toys, toilet paper, and cleaning supplies. Every day is different, and no two pallets are the same.

At AS Watson, you receive attractive allowances up to 150 percent and work within a clear two‑shift system. You will also become part of a friendly and motivated team.

- You take responsibility for your work and perform your tasks with accuracy.
- You are available to work in two shifts (06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00).
- You are flexible and can work full‑time or part‑time.
- You are available at least on Mondays, Tuesdays, and two Saturdays per month.
- You have your own means of transportation, such as a bicycle, e‑bike, scooter, or car.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a side job that you can combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for a part-time order picker for both the morning and evening shifts. These shifts alternate weekly. In this role, you ensure that all orders are prepared correctly, completely, and on time for shipment.

As an order picker, you start by collecting orders in the warehouse. Using a scanner and headset, you gather the correct products while carefully checking quantities and items.

Are all products complete? Then you ensure careful and safe packaging. You select the right packaging materials, label the order correctly, and perform a final check before it is shipped.

You will work in a two-shift system: a morning shift from 07:00 to 16:00 and an evening shift from 16:00 to 00:00, alternating weekly. This means you work the early shift one week and the late shift the next.

Additionally, you are willing to work one Saturday per month from 08:00 to 16:00.

- Available at least 2 working days per week
- Able to work in a two-shift system
- Flexible, including one Saturday every four weeks
- Physically capable of active work
- A team player who speaks Dutch or English
- Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required
